Read from the company's own earnings release (8-K Ex. 99) reconciliation lines, never from EPS, the Street or a guide-implied EPS. value must equal the sum of components. Only adjusted-basis sets need an entry: GAAP sets take the filings' own pre-tax income less operating income (trailing 4 quarters), which is the basis their Zacks bridge already uses.
